claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, dimethisoquin is unlikely to kill cells broadly; its only known activities (nicotinic acetylcholine receptor modulation and phosphoinositide stimulation) occur at higher concentrations and are not cytotoxic, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
